category_scope: Beauty & Personal Care (hair care, skin care, oral care); general rules where noted

languages.note: English is the listing language observed on all US help pages; no explicit language sentence was found in the US detail page rules. A+ supports additional language variations (Amazon's example: Spanish in the US).
'Detail page information must be added in the local language of the specific store.'
'Add detail page information in the local language of the specific store.' The India video policy requires spoken or written language in videos to be English.

'Detail page information must be added in the local language of the store concerned.' The page does not say whether English, Arabic or both are required, and Amazon's translation handling is not documented on the public pages retrieved - treat the Arabic entry as unverified.
Same sentence as the UAE page. The sell.amazon.sa site is offered in English and Arabic. Which language is mandatory for listing content is not documented publicly - unverified.

rules.requirement: Product titles (Item name) must not exceed 75 characters, including spaces. Applies to all product types except media product types.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: Official announcement (News_Amazon, updated 2026-06-10): 'Starting July 27, 2026, titles in all categories except for media will need to be 75 characters or less including spaces.' It replaces the 200-character limit that took effect on 2025-01-21. Rollout is gradual through 2026: titles still over 75 characters are progressively replaced by an AI recommendation, brand owners get 14 days to review in Review Listing Changes, and listings stay active meanwhile. A new listing must meet the limit when first created. Same text on the UK and India help pages. AE/SA are handled separately (title.max_length.ae_sa).

rules.requirement: UAE and Saudi Arabia: the local help page states that titles must not exceed 75 characters including spaces, but the applicability of this limit to these two stores is contradicted by other official pages.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United Arab Emirates)
rules.notes: Scope conflict for AE/SA: the US, UK and India versions of the title page say the title requirements apply to all stores 'except for Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkiye, and the United Arab Emirates', while the UAE and Saudi versions of the same page say they apply 'in all of our worldwide stores'. The AE/SA page also still says '200 or fewer characters is required' in its best-practice table, has no Item highlights field, and the AE/SA 'Product detail page rules' pages do not mention a 75-character limit. Treat 75 as a warning threshold only; do not hard-fail AE/SA titles on it until Amazon reconciles the pages.

rules.requirement: UAE and Saudi Arabia: 200 characters is the last limit that is stated without contradiction (2025 policy: 'For most product categories, titles may not exceed 200 characters, including spaces').
rules.source_title: New product title requirements effective from January 21, 2025 (News_Amazon announcement)
rules.notes: Source is the News_Amazon announcement of the January 21, 2025 requirements (India forum copy; the same post exists on the UK forum). The AE/SA title page still carries the sentence '200 or fewer characters is required because mobile screens truncate long titles'. No AE/SA-specific announcement was retrieved.

rules.requirement: Item highlights (new field displayed beneath the title in search results and on the detail page) is limited to 125 characters including spaces. The field is optional and can be filled once the title is 75 characters or fewer.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: Mandatory as a field limit, not as a required field. Amazon: 'you'll still have 200 characters ... split between Item name (75 characters) and Item highlights (125 characters)'. Item highlights display beneath the Item name on desktop and mobile effective 2026-08-10 and are an input for search. Not present on the AE/SA help pages.

rules.requirement: Write Item highlights as comma-separated phrases (materials, recommended use cases, compatibility), not full sentences; keep the brand name and the most important varying attributes in the Item name.
rules.source_title: Answers to your product title update questions (News_Amazon announcement)
rules.notes: From the title help page FAQ and the News_Amazon Q&A post. Do not add highlights to parent ASINs is a seller-reported tip only and is not recorded as a rule.

rules.requirement: Titles must not use the special characters ! $ ? _ { } ^ ¬ ¦. Other special characters such as ~ # < > * are allowed only in specific contexts (product identifiers such as 'Style #4301', measurements such as '<10 lb'); decorative use is not allowed.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: Brand names containing a prohibited character go in the Brand name field, which is exempt. Introduced 2025-01-21. For AE/SA the rule is corroborated by the local Enhance Listings page (a listing is rated 'Poor' when 'the title contains special characters') and by the local detail page rules ('Using bad data (HTML and special characters) in titles ... is prohibited'). Scope conflict for AE/SA: the US, UK and India versions of the title page say the title requirements apply to all stores 'except for Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkiye, and the United Arab Emirates', while the UAE and Saudi versions of the same page say they apply 'in all of our worldwide stores'.

rules.requirement: Titles must not contain promotional phrases such as 'free shipping' or '100% quality guaranteed'.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: AE/SA: also covered by the local detail page rules, which prohibit alternative shipping offers (such as free shipping) and promotional material in titles, descriptions, bullet points and images.

rules.requirement: A title must not contain the same word more than twice. Prepositions, articles and conjunctions are exempt; brand names count towards the limit.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: If part of a brand name appears in a different context (e.g. 'Old Navy' and 'Navy Blue') it is not counted as a duplicate.

rules.requirement: UAE and Saudi Arabia: the local title page lists the same two-occurrence word-repetition rule.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United Arab Emirates)
rules.notes: Downgraded to 'recommended' because of the scope conflict. Scope conflict for AE/SA: the US, UK and India versions of the title page say the title requirements apply to all stores 'except for Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkiye, and the United Arab Emirates', while the UAE and Saudi versions of the same page say they apply 'in all of our worldwide stores'.

rules.requirement: Titles must not include restricted phrases such as 'FSA/HSA eligible'.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: Listed under 'Content requirements' on the title page; the US detail page rules extend it to descriptions, bullet points and images. The UAE and Saudi title pages carry the same sentence, but those stores are left out here because of the scope conflict. Scope conflict for AE/SA: the US, UK and India versions of the title page say the title requirements apply to all stores 'except for Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkiye, and the United Arab Emirates', while the UAE and Saudi versions of the same page say they apply 'in all of our worldwide stores'.

rules.requirement: Titles must contain the minimum information needed to clearly describe the product (examples given: 'Amazon Essentials Dress', 'Columbia Hiking Boots', 'Sony Headphones').
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: The UAE and Saudi title pages carry the same sentence, but those stores are left out here because of the scope conflict. Scope conflict for AE/SA: the US, UK and India versions of the title page say the title requirements apply to all stores 'except for Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkiye, and the United Arab Emirates', while the UAE and Saudi versions of the same page say they apply 'in all of our worldwide stores'.

rules.requirement: Use capital letters only for the first letter of each word; do not write the whole title in capital letters; emojis, emoticons or symbols at the beginning of each word are prohibited. The same rule applies to bullet points and product descriptions.
rules.notes: Stated as a policy in the US, UK, UAE and Saudi 'Product detail page rules'. The title page adds: do not capitalize prepositions (in, on, over, with), conjunctions (and, or, for) or articles (the, a, an).

rules.requirement: India: capitalize the first letter of each word except prepositions, conjunctions and articles; do not use all caps.
rules.notes: On the India site this appears only in the best-practice table of the title page; the India detail page rules retrieved do not contain the capitalization policy sentence.

rules.requirement: Recommended word order: brand name, flavor or style, product type, key attribute, color, size or pack count, model number.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Use numerals instead of spelled-out numbers ('2' not 'two') and abbreviate measurements ('cm', 'oz', 'in', 'kg').
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Do not use subjective commentary such as 'Hot Item' or 'Best seller' in titles; avoid redundancy and decorative symbols.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: Best-practice table. Promotional phrases themselves are a hard requirement (title.prohibited_promotional_phrases).

rules.requirement: Include size and color in child ASIN titles only, not in the parent ASIN title. In Beauty (and Clothing, Accessories & Luggage, Sporting Goods) the detail page and search results show the parent ASIN title, so the parent title is the one customers see.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: The parent/child best-practice row is on all five pages; the Beauty display explanation is in the US, UK and India FAQ and on the US 'Variation display and customer experience' page.

rules.requirement: For multipacks and variety multipacks the product title must state the total quantity (x pack or x count) and must not conflict with the main image.
rules.notes: Only the US version of 'Multipack imaging standards' was retrieved.

rules.requirement: Bundle titles must include the word 'Bundle' and follow the standard product title requirements.
rules.notes: Only the US version of the bundling policy was retrieved.

rules.requirement: Do not use HTML, JavaScript or other code in product detail pages. As a special case, line breaks (</br>) may be used in the description.
rules.notes: Same policy on the UK and India pages (they add DHTML).

rules.requirement: UAE and Saudi Arabia: do not include HTML, DHTML, Java, scripts or other executables in detail pages; 'bad data (HTML and special characters)' in titles, descriptions, bullet points and any other attribute is prohibited.
rules.source_title: Product detail page rules (United Arab Emirates)
rules.notes: The AE/SA pages do not mention the line-break exception. Same text on the Saudi page.

rules.requirement: Titles, descriptions, bullet points and images must not contain: phone numbers, addresses, email addresses or website URLs; availability, price or condition details; links to other websites or alternative shipping offers such as free shipping; reviews, quotes or testimonials; requests for positive reviews; adverts, promotional material or watermarks; time-sensitive information; pornographic, obscene or offensive content.
rules.notes: Equivalent lists appear on the UK, India, UAE and Saudi 'Product detail page rules' pages (India adds social media handles and India-specific unlawful content categories).

rules.requirement: A maximum character length for the product description is not stated on the public help pages retrieved.
rules.notes: Attribute length limits are enforced per product type (the Attributes guide lists Error 90225 'Character limit exceeded'). Read the limit from the current listing template or the Product Type Definitions API schema instead of hard-coding a number.

rules.requirement: The description is shown in paragraph form and should elaborate on key features, uses, benefits and technical specifications; keep it concise, clear and consistent with other attributes.
rules.notes: Amazon reserves the right not to use all description or bullet content for search retrieval.

rules.requirement: Bundle descriptions must clearly state that the product is a bundle and identify all included items.
Include at least three bullet points.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Bullet points 'allow you to include up to five descriptive points' on the product detail page.
rules.notes: Stated on the US 'Optimize your product discoverability' page; the bullet point requirements page itself gives no maximum count. Not re-verified per country.

rules.requirement: Bullet point character limits vary by product type; no universal maximum is published.
rules.notes: Do not hard-code 255/500/1000 characters: take the limit from the product type definition or listing template. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Begin each bullet with a capital letter; write a sentence fragment without end punctuation; separate phrases with semicolons; use a header followed by a colon ('Cotton fabric: Made from 100% cotton'); write numbers one to nine in full except in names, model numbers and measurements; put a space between digit and unit ('60 ml').
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Highlight product features, benefits and how the product meets customer needs; avoid brand marketing stories; keep data consistent across variants and minimise duplication with the title, description or product overview.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Bullet points must not contain the special characters listed by Amazon: trademark, registered, euro, ellipsis, dagger, double dagger, cent, pound, yen, copyright, plus-minus, tilde and similar symbols.
rules.notes: Amazon's list verbatim: ™, ®, €, …, †, ‡, o, ¢, £, ¥, ©, ±, ~, â. Enforcement wording: bullet points containing prohibited elements 'may be removed or updated'. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Bullet points must not contain emojis, placeholder text ('not applicable', 'NA', 'n/a', 'not eligible', 'TBD', 'copy pending', ...) or ASINs.
rules.notes: Enforcement: may be removed or updated. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Bullet points must not contain the prohibited claims 'eco-friendly', 'environmentally friendly', 'ecologically friendly', 'anti-microbial', 'anti-bacterial', 'made from bamboo', 'contains bamboo', 'made from soy' or 'contains soy'.
rules.notes: The page refers to 'General listing restrictions' for detail. Enforcement: may be removed or updated. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Bullet points must not contain guarantee information ('Full refund', 'If not satisfied, send it back', 'Unconditional guarantee with no limit') or external information (company information, website links, external hyperlinks, contact information).
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Bullet points must not repeat the same information across bullets, use all caps ('MACHINE WASHABLE'), use abbreviations such as 'qty', 'pkg', 'w/', 'approx.', or repeat content that has a dedicated field (fabric content, care instructions, country of origin).
rules.notes: Enforcement: may be removed or updated. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Avoid subjective, performance or comparative claims unless verifiable on packaging; avoid unsubstantiated award claims or consumer survey results; do not refer to other products not included under the ASIN and do not compare with competitor brands.
rules.notes: Listed under best-practice 'Claims' and 'References' rows. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: For bundles, the first bullet must state that the product is a bundle of X items and identify the products in the bundle.

Required attributes must be completed to create a listing (examples given: product title, main image, product description, price). Required and recommended attributes vary by product type and must be read from the current bulk listing template or the Product Type Definitions API.
rules.notes: Attributes are grouped as Required / Recommended / All. Missing required attributes return Error 90220 or 99001. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: For attributes with a valid-value list, select only from the provided values; a value not in the list is rejected (Error 90057).
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Use only listing templates downloaded within the last 90 days so that they include the latest attribute requirements.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Enter the brand in the Brand name field; for products without a brand enter 'generic' in the Brand name field and do not put a brand name in the title.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)
rules.notes: From the title page FAQ on all five country versions; the US 'Listing quality' page adds that the brand field enables customer filtering.

rules.requirement: Child listings in Consumables (Grocery, Beauty, Pets, Health & Personal Care) without a unit count and value are suppressed from search and browse.
rules.notes: Only the US 'Suppressed listings' page was retrieved.

rules.requirement: Item Form (86 product types), Number of Items (154 product types) and Net Content (8 product types) are mandatory for the listed product types, and Unit Count Type is restricted to values allowed for the product type and item form (example: product type 'Shampoo' with item form 'Liquid' must use 'Fl Oz').
rules.source_title: Conditional Unit Count based on Item Form, Normalized Value of Size, Item Form, Number of Items and Net Content details
rules.notes: The per-product-type lists are in linked documents that were not retrieved. Invalid Unit Count Type values can cause catalog errors and removal from search until corrected.

rules.requirement: US cosmetics, skin and hair care policy: the product detail page must carry item name, product identifier and type (UPC, EAN, ISBN or GTIN), brand name, age range description, manufacturer, product features and number of items.
rules.source_title: Cosmetics, skin, and hair care (United States)
rules.notes: Children's cosmetics additionally need a mandatory cautionary statement and a minimum manufacturer age. Toothpastes are named in the policy's definition of cosmetics.

rules.requirement: The Generic keyword (search terms) field is required for 23 product types, including 'Beauty', 'Body care product' and 'Body deodorant'.

Which beauty-specific attributes (ingredients, scent, hair type, skin type, expiry or shelf life, country of origin, safety and compliance fields) are required per product type is not listed on the public help pages retrieved.
rules.notes: These requirements live in the product-type templates and in the Product Type Definitions API schema (required and conditionally required attributes), which need a seller login or SP-API credentials.

rules.requirement: India: products must not be listed at a price higher than the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) determined by the manufacturer.

A product ID (GTIN: UPC, EAN, JAN or ISBN) is required to create new listings in Beauty and in Health & Personal Care. Major brands require a UPC (UPC or EAN on the UK, UAE and Saudi pages); exemptions may be requested for private-label brands.
rules.notes: The category table was read on all five country sites; wording differs slightly (UK Beauty: exemptions 'may be granted for private label and specialised products').

rules.requirement: The most commonly used GTINs in the Amazon catalog are UPC, ISBN, EAN and JAN; the specific GTIN required for page creation and matching varies by category.

Amazon verifies product UPCs against the GS1 database; UPCs that do not match GS1 information are considered invalid, listings with invalid UPCs are removed and ASIN-creation or selling privileges may be removed. Obtain UPCs directly from GS1.
rules.notes: Only the US 'Valid UPCs' page was retrieved.

rules.requirement: Use only GTINs you own or are authorized to use; GTINs must be purchased directly from GS1 or used with explicit authorization from the GTIN prefix owner. Listing submissions with unauthorized GTINs will be blocked. False product identification information is prohibited.
rules.notes: Sentence present in the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi 'Product detail page rules'.

rules.requirement: A GTIN exemption can be requested for private-label or handmade products, products manufactured without barcodes, parts, bundles and generic products. It is not available when the product already has a GS1 barcode or the brand requires a UPC, and it must be requested separately for each store and category (product type).
rules.source_title: List products that do not have a product ID (UPC, EAN, JAN, or ISBN)
rules.notes: Timelines stated: brand owner or generic brand - automatic approval, wait 30 minutes before listing; other cases - within 48 hours. Application photos must show all sides of product and packaging with the brand permanently affixed.

rules.requirement: Each sellable unit needs its own product identifier: a multi-pack needs a separate UPC from the single item plus the item package quantity, and a bundle needs its own unique UPC or EAN.
The product ID of an existing listing cannot be edited unless the listing was created with a GTIN exemption.

Amazon Brand Registry (prerequisite for A+ Content and other brand tools) requires an active registered trademark in each country of enrolment, or a pending trademark at a subset of offices; accepted government trademark offices include the United States, India, the United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
rules.notes: Retrieved from the Amazon.ae product listing guide; the statement describes the global programme.

rules.requirement: Every product requires at least one compliant main image. If no main image meets the requirements Amazon may remove the listing from search until a compliant main image is provided.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: The main image must have a pure white background (RGB 255, 255, 255).
rules.notes: 'Non-white background' is a listed image-suppression reason. A lifestyle main image is allowed only for a few non-beauty product types (BED, BED_FRAME, MATTRESS, RUG, RUG_PAD, SOFA). Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Show the product as 85% of the main image.
rules.notes: 'Product too small' is a listed suppression reason (any image). Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: The main image must not contain text, logos, graphics or watermarks.
rules.notes: Listed suppression reason: 'Main image has text, logo, graphic, or watermark'. Only the US 'Image suppression' page was retrieved; the main-image requirements themselves are identical on all five image guides.

rules.requirement: Show the entire product within the frame (no cropping), show the product only once (not front and back together), show only one unit plus the accessories included, and never use a placeholder image.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Do not show accessories or props that are not included with the product, and do not include packaging unless it is an important product feature.
rules.notes: Multipacks are the documented exception: see images_main.multipack. Whether beauty products may show retail packaging is governed by the category style guide, which was not retrieved. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: For multipacks the main image must show the total quantity delivered to the customer and must show the product in its packaging. Amazon pack-quantity stickers or Amazon logos must not be added to the image by the seller.
For bundles the main image must include all products in the bundle and no product that is not part of it.
Images must be at least 500 pixels on the longest side; smaller images cannot be uploaded. Do not artificially enlarge small images.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Images with 1,000 or more pixels on the longest side enable the zoom function; Amazon recommends 1,000+ pixels.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Images must not exceed 10,000 pixels on the longest side.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Supported formats: JPEG (.jpg, .jpeg), TIFF (.tif, .tiff), PNG (.png) and non-animated GIF (.gif); JPEG is recommended. EPS, BMP, PDF and application-specific formats (PSD, AI, CDR, ...) are not accepted.
rules.notes: Unsupported-format list is from the US 'Technical image file requirements' page. No maximum file size for product images is stated on the pages retrieved (bulk upload: up to 1,000 images and 1 GB per zip).

rules.requirement: Image resolution must be at least 72 dpi; images must be clear, non-pixelated and without jagged edges.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: RGB colour mode is preferred; CMYK is not preferred and should be converted to RGB before upload.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Submit images with minimal or no compression (JPEG at the highest quality level, TIFF uncompressed), remove all layers, and do not rely on ICC colour profiles for accurate colour display.
rules.notes: Grayscale is acceptable only for images that accurately depict grey or silver metal products.

rules.requirement: No required aspect ratio for product images is stated on the public pages retrieved.
rules.notes: The image guide specifies longest-side pixel limits only.

rules.requirement: Upload at least six additional images and one video in addition to the main image.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: The maximum number of images accepted or displayed per listing is not stated on the public pages retrieved.
rules.notes: Variant codes PT01-PT99 exist, and Amazon states that uploading an image does not guarantee display because it selects and arranges images from multiple selling partners.

rules.requirement: All product images must accurately represent the product and match the title, and must not show nudity or sexually suggestive content, customer reviews, five-star imagery, claims such as 'free shipping', seller-specific information, Amazon logos or trademarks, or Amazon badges such as 'Amazon's Choice', 'Best seller' or 'Top seller'.
rules.notes: Images that fail the requirements cannot be uploaded or may be removed from search. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Swatch images must not contain text or pricing details.
rules.notes: Page wording: 'No text or pricing details (swatch image only)'. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Use the dedicated image variant codes: INGR for ingredient information, PS01-PS06 for product safety and compliance (warnings), DTLS for multipack images, PT01-PT99 for additional angles, in-use and detail shots.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: US cosmetics, skin and hair care policy: product images must include the ingredients list and a product identity statement (a clear statement of what the product is, such as 'shampoo' or 'moisturizing body lotion').
rules.source_title: Cosmetics, skin, and hair care (United States)
rules.notes: On request sellers must also submit images of the entire label in English (US contact for adverse-event reporting, product name, ingredient list, net contents in US customary units, warnings and fragrance allergens).

rules.requirement: If an image contains photorealistic AI-generated people it must be tagged before upload with the IPTC keyword 'contains-synthetic-performer' in the dc:subject (XMP) field.
rules.notes: The same disclosure rule is stated for videos and A+ images. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: For selected Beauty ASINs (lip colour, eye colour, foundation, concealer, skin moisturizer and cleanser) Amazon may insert a diversity image as the fourth image (PT03); the last image is pushed out if the image block is full.
rules.notes: Programme is managed by Amazon; sellers cannot edit this image.

rules.requirement: Video files must be MOV or MP4.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Maximum video file size is 5 GB.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Video resolution up to 1080p.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Aspect ratio 16:9 (horizontal) or 9:16 (vertical).
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Minimum video duration is 1 minute.
rules.notes: The specification table states 'Duration: 1-12 minutes'. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Maximum video duration is 12 minutes.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Thumbnail must be JPEG, PNG, GIF or BMP and under 5 MB; 1920 x 1080 pixels at 16:9 is recommended.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Videos can be uploaded when the selling account has been active for more than three months (brand-registered or not), the ASINs exist and are listed, and each video is associated with at least one ASIN.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Videos must not include external website links, promotional calls to action, unauthorized music or artwork, visible third-party or external branding, promotional content, or misleading or incorrect claims; they must comply with the Community guidelines.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: India: the detail page rules add a video policy - up to 10 videos per product; spoken or written language must be English; no pricing, guarantees, environmental claims, competitor comparisons, URLs or references to other retailers; superlative claims ('#1 rated', 'Best-Selling', '100%') only with third-party evidence shown in the video; file size must not exceed 500 MB.
rules.notes: Conflict within Amazon India help: the India 'Shoppable video guide' gives MOV/MP4 and a 5 GB limit, while this policy lists other formats and 500 MB. Use the stricter value until clarified.

rules.requirement: A+ Content is available to brand owners and authorized resellers: the account role must be brand representative or reseller, ASINs must be registered to the brand, and the brand name on the ASIN must exactly match Brand Registry (case sensitive).
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: A+ Content is available at no additional cost for Basic and Premium features, and there is no additional eligibility criterion for sellers to access Premium A+.
rules.notes: This removes the earlier brand-story/approved-projects prerequisites that third-party guides still describe. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Basic A+: up to 5 modules on the detail page, chosen from 14 module types; image size 970 x 300; comparison chart supported; no video, hotspots or navigation carousel.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Premium A+: up to 7 modules on the detail page, chosen from 19 module types; image size 1464 x 600; comparison chart, video, hotspots and navigation carousel supported.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: A+ Brand Story appears in the 'From the brand' section and supports one module with up to 19 pre-formatted cards in a carousel; it can be used alongside Basic or Premium A+.
rules.notes: Not supported for Books, Music, Video or DVD. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: A+ images must be .jpg, .bmp or .png in RGB colour space, under 2 MB per file and at least 72 dpi; animated images (GIF) and CMYK are not allowed.
rules.notes: Images larger than the module size are resized automatically. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Alt-text (formerly image keywords) must be supplied for every A+ image and must describe the image.
rules.notes: Alt-text that does not describe the image can cause rejection (A+ content guidelines).

rules.requirement: A+ Content must not contain HTML tags, watermarks, QR codes, hyperlinks or external redirects.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: A+ Content must not include time-sensitive references, promotional language or pricing, competitor comparisons, external links or contact information, warranty or guarantee information, shipping details, personal information, images duplicated from the gallery, blurry images or small unreadable text.
rules.notes: 'Not acceptable' column of the guide. Time-sensitive references are permitted in the Brand Story section per the US guidelines page. Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: Comparison charts may only compare against other products owned by the same brand; comparisons against categories (for example LED versus halogen bulbs) are acceptable.
rules.notes: Detailed wording from the US 'A+ content guidelines'; the guide on all five sites says 'Use comparison charts for same-brand products'.

rules.requirement: A+ claims rules: awards and endorsements need date and awarding body and must not be older than 2 years; certification claims need substantiation in the text; environmental claims such as 'eco-friendly', 'biodegradable' and 'compostable' are not allowed; satisfaction and boastful claims ('100% satisfaction guaranteed', '#1 rated', 'top-rated', 'best-selling') are not allowed; claims to cure, mitigate, treat or prevent disease must be removed for drugs, cosmetics and health products; at most four quotes or endorsements, only from well-known publications or public figures.
rules.notes: Only the US 'A+ content guidelines' page was retrieved. Violations can lead to rejection or removal of the ASIN as a restricted product.

rules.requirement: A+ Content must not reference the company as seller or distributor or mention seller authorization, must not use purchase-directing language ('buy now', 'add to cart'), price words ('affordable', 'cheap', 'free', 'bonus'), stand-alone trademark or copyright symbols, off-Amazon customer service references, or imitations of Amazon logos and detail-page headings.

A+ text must be in the content language selected for the project (a small amount of other-language text is allowed only as part of the brand identity); content is shown only on the detail page of the language it was published in.
rules.notes: Amazon may create language variations or cross-country translations automatically where no content was published before; these can be edited or deleted (Create A+ content, US).

rules.requirement: A maximum of 20 A+ submissions can be pending review at one time.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: A+ writing style: unique content that does not duplicate the image gallery; paragraphs of at most three sentences; numbers under 10 spelled out; serial commas; sparing bold and italic; content formatted for mobile.
rules.notes: Identical rule text was verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi Arabia versions of this help page on 2026-11-26; the US URL is cited.

rules.requirement: First-party vendors create A+ in Vendor Central (Advertising > A+ Content Manager). A seller cannot add A+ to an ASIN that already has A+ contributed by a retail vendor.
rules.notes: The Vendor Central path is quoted in the public A+ Content guide; the 'retail contribution' error is in the US FAQ. Vendor Central help itself is login-gated and was not read.

rules.requirement: Search terms (Generic keyword attribute) must be less than 250 bytes in total. If the limit is exceeded, none of the search terms for that product are indexed.
rules.notes: 'Less than 250 bytes' is stated on the US search-optimization and keyword-attribute pages (table value 249), on the UK and UAE search-terms pages, on the India page ('under 250 bytes'; over the limit 'none of the search terms ... will be indexed') and on the Saudi search-optimization page. Conflict: the 'Attributes guide' on all five sites describes Error 97779 as 'generic keywords exceed our length limit of 200 bytes'. Spaces and punctuation are not counted; one byte per ASCII character, two or more for accented, Arabic or other non-Latin characters.

rules.requirement: Search terms must not contain brand names (your own or others'), ASINs, profanity, temporary statements ('new', 'on sale now'), subjective claims ('best', 'cheapest', 'amazing') or offensive terms.
rules.notes: 'Violating the rules ... may result in your ASIN being suppressed and may put the health of your selling account at risk.' Equivalent lists on the UK, India, UAE and Saudi pages.

rules.requirement: Search-term style: use synonyms, spelling variations (not misspellings) and abbreviations; all lower case; no punctuation; separate words with spaces; do not repeat words; omit stop words (a, an, and, by, for, of, the, with); use singular or plural, not both.
Each ASIN must be classified to the most specific browse node; the Item Type Keyword must match the spelling and formatting in the Browse Tree Guide. ASINs without a browse node are not indexed.
rules.notes: Products that do not comply with detail page rules 'may be suppressed from search until the quality issues are resolved'.

rules.requirement: Other keyword attributes have byte limits beyond which content is ignored: item_type_keyword 250, specific_uses_keywords 150 (being phased out), style_keywords 100, subject_keywords 210 (media only), thesaurus_subject_keywords 250; platinum_keywords are no longer used.
Amazon may not use all supplied search terms, description or bullet content for search retrieval, and it does not guarantee a specific placement in search results.

Create a variation family only for products that are fundamentally the same and differ only by variation attributes such as size, colour, flavour, scent or quantity. Parent and child products must be the same product type and brand, serve the same function and have similar titles and images.
rules.notes: 'Only create valid variations that relate to the primary product' is also a detail-page policy on the US, UK and India sites.

rules.requirement: Use only Amazon's standard variation themes available for the product type, and use each theme only for its intended attribute (a colour theme must contain colour information only).

Use the 'number of items' variation attribute when identical items are offered in different pack quantities; the size attribute may express dimensions, standardized sizes or quantity but not useful life or compatibility.

In Beauty the detail page shows the parent product's title and description without varying attribute information until the customer selects a child; in search, the parent appears for these categories.
rules.notes: Sellers cannot change the order of variation children.

rules.requirement: A bundle combines two or more complementary (different) products and is branded and categorized by its primary product; multi-packs of identical items are not bundles. Hard-kit bundles are allowed only when packaged by the original manufacturer or brand with a unique identifier (exceptions: gift baskets, camera kits, or a letter of authorization); virtual bundles are created in the Virtual Bundles tool and cannot be created via spreadsheets or APIs.
rules.notes: The virtual bundles option 'may not yet be available for your store, brand, or fulfillment channel combination'.

rules.requirement: Detail page information must be added in the local language of the store concerned.
rules.source_title: Product detail page rules (United Arab Emirates)
rules.notes: AE and SA: 'Detail page information must be added in the local language of the store concerned.' UK and India: 'in the local language of the specific store'. The pages do not name the language; for AE/SA see language.ae_sa_arabic_english. The US detail page rules retrieved contain no language sentence.

rules.requirement: Whether sellers on amazon.ae and amazon.sa must supply both English and Arabic content, and how Amazon translates between the two, is not documented on the public pages retrieved.
rules.source_title: Product detail page rules (United Arab Emirates)
rules.notes: Evidence found: the local-language sentence above; A+ content is published per language and shown only on that language's page; videos carry a language selection. Treat bilingual completeness as a best practice to confirm in Seller Central.

rules.requirement: For country-specific image uploads, any text in the images must be in the country's official language or English.
rules.notes: Stated on the US 'Upload images' page for country-specific uploads; US-specific images use the Global option.

rules.requirement: Select the language used in each video at upload; the list shows the languages supported in that store.
Title and Item highlights changes are accepted immediately but take 24 to 48 hours to be processed and displayed.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)

rules.requirement: When Amazon applies AI-generated title or Item highlights changes to non-compliant listings, brand owners have 14 days before implementation to review, modify and approve them in Review Listing Changes.
rules.source_title: Updates to improve your product titles begin on July 27 (News_Amazon announcement)

rules.requirement: A non-compliant or inaccurate title on an existing listing may be automatically corrected or may not appear in search results; suppressed titles are listed under 'Search suppressed and inactive listings' in Manage All Inventory and suppression is lifted automatically once the title complies.
rules.source_title: Product title requirements and guidelines (United States)

rules.requirement: A newly uploaded image that is selected for display can take up to 24 hours to appear on the detail page.
A+ Content is reviewed within up to seven business days (longer in the holiday season; no expedited requests) and is published within 24 hours of approval.
rules.source_title: Content publishing status and content rejection

rules.requirement: Video review takes 1-7 business days; publication to the detail page follows within three days of approval.
Changes to an ASIN's offer, browse node or launch date can take up to 72 hours to be reflected in shopping results.
The Listing Quality Indicator refreshes within 15 minutes of publishing updates in the Enhance view; verified contributions appear on the detail page within 48 hours.

Listings must not state or imply that a product diagnoses, cures, mitigates, treats or prevents a disease in humans or animals without FDA approval. Amazon's example list of terms that products cannot claim includes 'Anti-Bacterial', 'Anti-Fungal', 'Anti-Microbial' and 'Nano silver' alongside named diseases.
rules.notes: Policy applies to claims on detail pages, images, descriptions, packaging and marketing materials in all categories; violations can lead to product removal, listing restrictions and account penalties.

rules.requirement: Claims that a product is anti-microbial or anti-bacterial need supporting proof on request, and products claimed to have antimicrobial, antifungal, antibacterial or other pesticidal properties must comply with FIFRA (US pesticide law) and state pesticide laws.
rules.notes: Pesticide claims are defined as statements that a product is intended to prevent, destroy, repel or mitigate a pest (Misleading and prohibited claims).

rules.requirement: Cosmetics listings and images must not include the FDA logo and must not claim 'FDA approved' unless the product has official FDA approval.
rules.source_title: Cosmetics, skin, and hair care (United States)

rules.requirement: A cosmetic may claim to reduce the appearance of wrinkles but may not claim to eliminate wrinkles. Products that are both cosmetic and drug (anti-dandruff shampoo, sunscreen-containing moisturizers, antiperspirant deodorant) must follow the FDA OTC monograph or an approved NDA for their claims.
rules.source_title: Cosmetics, skin, and hair care (United States)

rules.requirement: Do not make unverified claims of health benefits, therapeutic properties or purity levels without evidence from certified testing; superlatives and comparisons ('best', '100% pure', 'guaranteed', 'twice as effective') may be used only when supported by verifiable, objective proof.
Environmental claims must be truthful, not misleading and supported by evidence (FTC Green Guides); general terms such as 'eco-friendly' are identified as potentially problematic.
rules.notes: In bullet points the terms 'eco-friendly', 'environmentally friendly' and 'ecologically friendly' are listed as prohibited on all five country sites (bullets.prohibited_claims).

rules.requirement: Phrases like 'satisfaction guaranteed' or 'money-back guarantee' may be used only if full refunds are given for any reason; testimonials and endorsements must follow the FTC Endorsement Guides; reviews, quotes and testimonials are not allowed in titles, descriptions, bullet points or images.

Do not make competitor comparisons in A+ Content and do not use brand names (your own or others') in search terms; in bullet points Amazon's writing guidance is not to compare the product with competitor brands or refer to other products.
rules.notes: Mandatory for A+ ('Not acceptable: make competitor comparisons') and for search terms (prohibited words; ASIN may be suppressed). For bullet points the instruction sits in the best-practice table rather than in the prohibited-content table.

rules.requirement: US regulatory note cited by Amazon: cosmetics must comply with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, the Fair Packaging and Labeling Act and MoCRA (Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022). Offers must be new and sealed with visible lot or matrix codes. Skin-lightening products need validation by an Amazon-authorized testing provider, including a GMP certificate and FDA Forms 5066 and 5067 (facility registration and product listing).
rules.source_title: Cosmetics, skin, and hair care (United States)
rules.notes: Listed prohibited items include products with mercury, minoxidil above 5%, hydrogen peroxide above 12%, eye makeup with kohl/kajal/surma, plastic microbeads and products named in FDA recalls or warning letters.

rules.requirement: UK regulatory note cited by Amazon: cosmetics sold in Great Britain must comply with the UK (GB) Cosmetics Regulation - a Cosmetics responsible person established in the UK, notification on the UK Submit Cosmetic Product Notification service, a product information file, and labelling including the responsible person's name and address. Northern Ireland follows the EU Cosmetics Regulation and CPNP notification.

UK: listings must not claim that a product is intended for the diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment or prevention of disease, must not convey misleading product information, and imitation perfumes must not be described as 'similar to' or 'inspired by' an original fragrance or use its name.
rules.notes: Also prohibited: testers, decanted perfumes, expired or unsealed products, products with hydroquinone, skin creams with mercury, face and hand products with more than 1% kojic acid.

rules.requirement: Teeth-whitening products that contain or release more than 0.1% hydrogen peroxide are not permitted (restricted to professional use).
rules.notes: Given as the example of a professional-use ingredient limit on the UK, UAE and Saudi 'Cosmetics' pages.

rules.requirement: UAE: only packaged beauty products that are appropriately described and labelled may be listed, and the seller must be approved by Amazon to sell in this category. Prohibited: expired, opened, unsealed or tester products, products with prohibited ingredients referenced in the Dubai Municipality label-assessment procedures, products claiming to contain snake oil, non-natural henna for skin.
rules.notes: The page cites Dubai Municipality circulars and EU Regulation 1223/2009. It does not mention ESMA, ECAS, MoIAT or Montaji registration; no Amazon source for such a requirement was found.

rules.requirement: Saudi Arabia: only packaged beauty products that are appropriately described and labelled may be listed, and the seller must be approved by Amazon to sell in this category; the same prohibited examples as the UAE apply.
rules.notes: The page cites the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) cosmetics department, the SFDA product notification system and SASO technical standards as reference material; it does not spell out an SFDA listing-number field.

rules.requirement: India: prohibited listings include products claiming to diagnose, cure, mitigate, treat or prevent disease unless approved by the food and drugs regulatory authorities, products barred from advertising under the Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisement) Act, 1954, products banned by CDSCO, and expired, opened, unsealed or tester products.
rules.notes: The page lists the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 as additional information.

rules.requirement: No explicit Amazon rule on before/after images for beauty products was found on the public pages retrieved.
rules.notes: General rules still apply: images must not contain claims that are misleading or unsubstantiated.

rules.requirement: Sellers remain responsible for reviewing AI-generated listing and A+ suggestions: generated content can include features and claims that were not in the original listing and must be verified for accuracy and policy compliance before acceptance.

enhanced_content.official_name: A+ Content (Basic A+, Premium A+, A+ Brand Story)
enhanced_content.eligibility: Brand owners and authorized resellers whose brand is enrolled in Amazon Brand Registry: account role brand representative or reseller, ASINs registered to the brand, brand name matching Brand Registry exactly. No additional cost and no additional eligibility criteria for Premium A+. First-party vendors use A+ Content Manager in Vendor Central. Not supported for Books, Music, Video and DVD.
enhanced_content.modules_note: Basic: up to 5 modules from 14 types, images 970 x 300, comparison chart. Premium: up to 7 modules from 19 types, images 1464 x 600, video, hotspots, carousel, Q&A. Brand Story: one module with up to 19 carousel cards in 'From the brand'. Images .jpg/.bmp/.png, RGB, under 2 MB, 72 dpi minimum; alt-text mandatory; no HTML, GIF, watermarks, QR codes or links. Review up to 7 business days, publication within 24 hours, maximum 20 pending submissions. Same guide text on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi sites.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: How complete and correct a product detail page is compared with best-in-class listings in similar categories. It is a directional indicator; it does not account for price, fulfilment or seasonality.
official_quality_signals.components: Two pillars: Content quality (titles, bullet points, key attributes - correctness, completeness, policy compliance) and Multimedia quality (image and A+ content quality and completeness). Result is one of five categories: Poor, Fair, Good, Great, Optimized - not a number.
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Selling partners in Seller Central: Manage Products > Enhance tab (per-ASIN side panel with factors and AI-generated suggestions; 'Improve listing quality in bulk').
official_quality_signals.notes: Verified on the US, UK, India, UAE and Saudi help sites. No API or downloadable report for the indicator is documented on the pages retrieved. Refreshes within 15 minutes of publishing updates.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Amazon's published definition of a quality listing.
official_quality_signals.components: Title, bullet points, attributes, images, video, A+ Content and search optimization.
official_quality_signals.notes: Conceptual framework, not a score. The page sends sellers to the Enhance tab to identify and fix listing-quality issues. The older name 'Listing Quality Dashboard' does not appear on any public help page retrieved on 2026-11-26.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Validation and catalog-pipeline issues on a seller SKU that can make a listing inactive, suppressed from search or otherwise deficient.
official_quality_signals.components: Issue list per SKU with code, message, severity (ERROR and WARNING appear in the documentation examples), affected attribute names, issue categories (for example INVALID_PRICE) and enforcement actions (the notification example lists SEARCH_SUPPRESSED, LISTING_SUPPRESSED, ATTRIBUTE_SUPPRESSED and CATALOG_ITEM_REMOVED). Synchronous issues on submission; asynchronous issues after processing.
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: SP-API developers and integrators acting for a selling partner.
official_quality_signals.notes: Retrieve with getListingsItem or searchListingsItems using includedData=issues; subscribe to the LISTINGS_ITEM_ISSUES_CHANGE notification; JSON_LISTINGS_FEED processing reports include issues when requested; mode=VALIDATION_PREVIEW previews errors before submission (low rate limit, testing only). Available for all categories in all stores per the Seller Central 'Listings APIs' page.

official_quality_signals.official_name: Search suppression / 'Fix' tab and Suppressed Listings Report
official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Listings hidden from search and browse because required elements are missing or policies are violated (main image, category/item type, title, unit count for consumables, title policy violations).
official_quality_signals.components: List of suppressed listings with reasons and next steps.
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Sellers in Seller Central (Manage Products > Fix tab; 'Search suppressed and inactive listings') and SP-API users via report type GET_MERCHANTS_LISTINGS_FYP_REPORT (Suppressed Listings Report, tab-delimited, one store per report).
official_quality_signals.notes: The US 'Suppressed listings' help page still carries legacy wording about titles of 'less than 80 characters for apparel, shoes, and luggage categories and 130 characters for all other categories'; this predates the 75-character rule and was not used as a rule.

official_quality_signals.official_name: A+ Content Manager - Content Quality Analysis
official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Quality of published A+ content: readability, information completeness, visual presentation and conversion effectiveness, assessed by an AI system; low-quality A+ may be shown collapsed by default.
official_quality_signals.components: Personalized recommendations and status per A+ project (details only inside the tool).
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Brand-registered sellers and vendors with A+ Content Manager access.
official_quality_signals.notes: Only the existence of the 'Content Quality Analysis' tab and the evaluation factors are public.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Images that failed technical or policy checks after upload.
official_quality_signals.components: Per-file failure reasons (for example non-white background, text or watermark on main image, cropped product).
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Sellers in Seller Central (Submission status > Content compliance issues report type).
official_quality_signals.notes: Image-related listing issues are also returned by the Listings Items API issues mechanism.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: No official Amazon score with this name was found.
official_quality_signals.notes: 'Retail readiness' is used in Amazon Ads education material as a checklist concept; five candidate advertising.amazon.com URLs returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-26 and web search was unavailable, so no official definition could be retrieved. Do not present it as an Amazon metric.

non_official_terms_to_avoid.what_it_actually_is: Not an Amazon metric. It is a SellerApp score: 'Listing quality index (LQI) is a weighted score assigned to the product listing based on 6 different sections' (bullet points, description, images, fulfilment method, reviews, rating), shown in the SellerApp dashboard. Amazon's own term is 'Listing Quality Indicator', which is a five-level category, not an index.
A Jungle Scout Listing Builder feature that scores how well a draft listing follows optimization best practices. Third-party, not issued by Amazon.

Amazon does not publish a numeric listing-quality score for sellers; the official indicator is categorical (Poor, Fair, Good, Great, Optimized). Numeric scores come from third-party tools. (Walmart, by contrast, does publish a numeric Listing Quality score.)
Legacy tool name that does not appear on any public Seller Central help page retrieved on 2026-11-26; the current official location is Manage Products > Enhance tab ('Enhance Listings').
No official Amazon score of this name could be verified; treat as an informal advertising checklist concept.

limitations: Evidence is limited to pages that were publicly reachable without login on 2026-11-26. Seller Central public help pages are JavaScript-rendered and were read with a headless browser; they show no last-updated date. Not retrieved: the Beauty category style guide PDF and product-type listing templates (login-gated), so beauty-specific attribute requirements, per-product-type character limits (bullets, description) and any beauty main-image exceptions are not recorded; Vendor Central help (first-party vendors); any Amazon Ads 'retail readiness' page. The 75-character title rule is verified for the US, UK and India; for the UAE and Saudi Arabia official pages contradict each other and the rule is recorded as a recommendation. The search-term limit is recorded as 'less than 250 bytes' although one official page mentions 200 bytes in an error description. US-only pages (cosmetics policy, claims policy, bundling, variations, multipack images, A+ guidelines) are scoped to the US even where the policy probably applies elsewhere. The web-search quota for the session was exhausted part-way through, so later pages were reached only by following links from official sites.
